title: Benefit Shares, Excesses and Caps Under Pass and Trip Protection
content:
The benefit side of a Pass and Trip Protection plan is set by four kinds of figure: the share of the covered
value the plan pays for each kind of event, the excess the household bears on every claim, the caps that hold
what one claim and what a whole season may pay, and the number of claims the plan will entertain in a season.

**Shares by event**

| Plan | Medical share | Loss of employment share | Permanent move share | Mountain closure share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 60.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 80.00 per cent | 70.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 100.00 per cent | 90.00 per cent | 75.00 per cent | 50.00 per cent |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 80.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 100.00 per cent | 85.00 per cent | 0.00 per cent | 60.00 per cent |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 100.00 per cent | 100.00 per cent | 90.00 per cent | 80.00 per cent |

**Limits, excess and claim allowance**

| Plan | Share of covered value the season limit is set at | Most one claim pays (USD) | Most the season pays (USD) | Claims entertained in a season | Excess borne on every claim (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Season Pass Protection Basic | 60.00 per cent | 700.00 | 700.00 | 1 | 75.00 |
| Season Pass Protection Plus | 80.00 per cent | 1600.00 | 2000.00 | 1 | 50.00 |
| Season Pass Protection Premier | 100.00 per cent | 2649.00 | 2649.00 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Collective Trip Protection Standard | 80.00 per cent | 6000.00 | 9000.00 | 2 | 150.00 |
| Collective Trip Protection Elite | 100.00 per cent | 15000.00 | 18000.00 | 3 | 100.00 |
| Collective Total Protection Concierge | 100.00 per cent | 45000.00 | 60000.00 | 5 | 0.00 |

**Points of judgement.** On Season Pass Protection Basic and Season Pass Protection Premier the cap on one
claim and the cap on the season are the same figure, so one claim at the cap exhausts the season. On the other
four plans the season cap stands above the single-claim cap. Season Pass Protection Premier and the
Collective Total Protection Concierge plan carry no excess at all, the household bearing nothing before the
plan pays; the largest excess in the schedule is the 150.00 USD borne on Collective Trip Protection Standard.
